title: 1-1 prep - Ryan Kim
content:
Quick context: Ryan is IC3 backend engineer (inference runtime). Focus last quarter on KV cache improvements + LRU eviction edge cases. Promoted candidate for IC4 later this year; manager will discuss growth plan and scope.

Agenda rough (30 min):
- 5m: quick personal check-in (how's bandwidth, time off, morale)
- 8m: project update (KV cache rollout status, perf numbers vs target, any regressions)
- 7m: blockers & support (what do you need from me / SRE / infra)
- 5m: career / growth (IC4 readiness, stretch projects, mentoring)
- 5m: action items & next steps

Prep notes / prompts to ask:
- KV cache: where are we on the tail-latency regression that showed up in canary? Which change coincided with the regression (PR/commit)?
- Perf: latest p95 and p99 numbers vs baseline (include env: dedicated staging vs prod canary). If you don't have exact numbers, ask to pull the perf dashboard during the 1:1.
- Rollout plan: current canary percentage, rollback criteria, rollout schedule. Are we blocked by infra capacity or user-facing tests?
- Tests: any flaky unit/integration tests related to LRU eviction? Are we missing a reproducible e2e for the corner case?
- Postmortem: if regression is still unexplained, suggest short blameless postmortem doc and assign owner.
- Career: discuss key signals for IC4 (design ownership, cross-team impact, mentorship). Suggest 2-3 concrete goals for next 6 months: lead a cross-team perf initiative, own a rollout doc + SLO definition, pair-program and onboard one new hire.

Blockers flagged by Ryan (notes from Slack):
- blocked on infra quota for running longer canaries (cost/approval loop)
- needs a test harness to reproduce LRU edge-case locally (no one has time yet)
- wants clearer acceptance criteria from product for behavior under cache-miss spikes

My asks / things I can do during week:
- escalate infra quota to infra eng manager (I will ping Priya)
- carve out 2 dev-hours to pair on reproducer this week (booked Thurs AM)
- help draft canary rollback/runbook and share with SRE for signoff
- connect Ryan with Lina (product) for acceptance criteria sync

Potential action items to assign in meeting:
- Ryan: follow up with PR that adds extra logging and a small synthetic test (due 2026-03-10)
- Jordan (me): escalate infra quota + schedule meeting with infra by 2026-03-06
- Ryan + SRE: quick canary run with increased tracing (owner: SRE lead, target 2026-03-08)
- Ryan: draft short postmortem template if regression persists (due 2026-03-12)

Signals to watch (metrics):
- p95/p99 latency for generate endpoint (tokens/sec) pre/post change
- error rate (5xx) correlated with canary rollout times
- request queue length and GPU utilization during high QPS windows

Notes / reminders to self:
- Keep conversation coaching-forward: focus on solutions and career growth, avoid micromanaging implementation details unless asked.
- If Ryan expresses frustration about approval loops, empathize and commit to specific escalation steps.
- Follow up: send summary + action items in Slack thread after 1:1, cc: Priya when escalating infra quota.

Open questions to resolve after meeting:
- Do we need a small dedicated canary node group to reduce noise from multi-tenant infra? (if yes, cost estimate needed)
- Is there appetite for carving out a 0.2 FTE for a small infra test harness this quarter?

Quick links to check during the sync:
- perf dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/generations/kv-cache-performance
- canary job: /ci/runs/kv-cache-canary/latest
- related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/4582

End of notes.
